description: This file defines CRUD operations for managing InputVariable entities related to test files and test cases within a testing management system, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions.

methods.name: List[InputVariable] get_variables_by_test_file(db: Session, test_file_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves all input variables associated with a specific test file ID, excluding those linked to test cases.

methods.name: List[InputVariable] get_variables_by_testcase(db: Session, test_file_id: int, testcase_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves all input variables associated with a specific test case ID within a test file.

methods.name: List[InputVariable] create_variables_bulk(db: Session, variables: List[dict], test_file_id: int, testcase_id: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Creates multiple input variables in bulk, associating them with a specific test file and optionally with a test case.

methods.name: bool delete_variables_by_test_file(db: Session, test_file_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes all input variables linked to a specific test file.

search-terms: delete input variables by test file
